# Persistent room damage and friendly combat strength

Sample25 Ring7's original58-input native defeat installs Inferno21 on the
champion's main floor2. Fixed-floor0/1/2 tactical predictions repeat the same
mistake: room attachments inherit the preferred army floor, and recurring50
damage removes the army before its later combats.

284 orders calibrated mixed-team pre-combat damage by its actual room targets,
including friendly health and combat strength exposed to repeated damage.
A living champion contributes the existing large protection penalty even
when the first hit is not lethal. This changes seed order only; all actions
and model effects remain available through the normal enumerator. Both cheap
policies use the same estimate without extra combat simulation in ranking.

`--inferno-placement-policy-only` reuses the unchanged original terminal-Pyre
fixture. It verifies the full original card successor/RNG, the two supported
floor choices and existing guarded floor0, both policies after their ordinary
preceding abilities, immutable roots, independently replayed alternative
successors and absence of Inferno pre-combat damage on the champion's floor.
Floor0 still requires its retained preview occupant21; this change does not
silently accept that unknown branch. The original direct room friendly-fire
and enemy-only damage controls remain separate checks.

Three full policy continuations all now reach the same moon-callback guard
after generated Dusk Mantle activation. The20-input original native component
044122-cf660e52 observes that boundary for subsequent calibration. Neither
the policy check nor a model-only continuation is a seventh native victory.
